name: Nov to Dec 2026: 5 Day Hypertrophy Block

weeks.note: Deload: loads down 30 to 40%. Hold intake, do not cut.

rules: Superset key: A1 then A2 back to back, rest only after the second exercise. A letter on its own (A, D) is a straight set.
Double progression: once every set hits the top of the rep range at the week's target RIR, add the smallest increment next week.
Warm-up: 2 to 3 ramp sets before the first exercise (about 50% x 8, 70% x 5, 85% x 2 to 3). One feeder set for later exercises.
Friday: if Bootcamp has flattened you, cap everything at 2 RIR rather than skipping the session.
Wednesday is the longest session. If short of time, drop the hanging leg raises first.
Drop sets: final set only, reduce the load by 25 to 30% and continue to failure.

warmup: Band pull aparts and dynamic chest stretches

notes: Weekly check-in this evening. Use the weekly average weight, not single days.

meals.name: Lunch
items: 150 g chicken breast, cooked weight, air fryer

notes: Weighing: meat is cooked weight, rice is dry weight. Weigh nuts and nut butter rather than eyeballing them.
Creatine: one MFA serving gives roughly 1.8 g, under a maintenance dose. Start 5 g of standalone monohydrate once the tubs run out.
Salt: MFA carries 0.8 g at meal three. Keep added salt light elsewhere and hold the day to 5 g to 6 g.
Steps: 10,000 or more daily alongside this.
Still open: swap the lunch chicken for 130 g cooked salmon twice a week for omega 3. Consider vitamin D through autumn and winter.
If weight stalls past 14 days, trim 10 g to 15 g of carbohydrate from lunch first.
